4.10.1 Compute the Free Resolution
A free resolution of a module M can be thought of as the process of approxi-
mating M by free modules; it is constructed iteratively by starting with a set
of generators for M , then determining the relations among these generators,
the so-called first syzygies, then the relations among these relations, the
second syzygies, and so forth. If, for some ℓ, there are no relations among
